# Lightspeed routes

Every route lightspeed's surface serves -- vendor-facing only. The `/__unit/*` control plane is the same for every vendor; see [Control plane](control-plane.md).

| Method | Path | Operation | Capability | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/connect` | Connect | auth | Stand-in (the real authorize page is on secure.retail.lightspeed.app): approves and redirects to redirect_uri with a single-use code and the state. |
| POST | `/api/1.0/token` | TokenExchange | auth | Exchange an authorization code, or refresh: rotation retires the refresh token and revokes the access token issued with it. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/retailer` | GetRetailer | retailer | Information about this retailer: currency, timezone, country and domain prefix. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/outlets` | ListOutlets | outlets | Outlets, ascending by version; after/before/page_size/deleted. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/outlets/{outlet_id}` | GetOutletByID | outlets | One outlet by id. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/registers` | ListRegisters | registers | Registers, ascending by version; after/before/page_size/deleted. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/registers/{register_id}` | GetRegisterByID | registers | One register by id. |
| PUT | `/api/2026-07/registers/{register_id}/actions/open` | OpenRegister | registers | Open a register. 409 if it is already open. |
| PUT | `/api/2026-07/registers/{register_id}/actions/close` | CloseRegister | registers | Close a register and record its totals; fires register_closure.create. 409 if closed. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/registers/{register_id}/payments_summary` | RegisterPaymentsSummary | registers | Payment totals for a register's most recent closure. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/payment_types` | ListPaymentTypes | payment_types | Payment types, ascending by version; internal types excluded, as the scope says. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/webhooks` | ListWebhooks | webhooks | All webhooks: {"data": [...]}, with no version envelope. Vendor operationId: get-webhooks. |
| POST | `/api/2026-07/webhooks` | CreateWebhook | webhooks | Create a webhook; 201, or 409 when the type and URL pair already exists. Vendor: post-webhooks. |
| GET | `/api/2026-07/webhooks/{webhookId}` | GetWebhook | webhooks | One webhook by id; 404 otherwise. Vendor operationId: get-webhooks-id. |
| PUT | `/api/2026-07/webhooks/{webhookId}` | UpdateWebhook | webhooks | Replace a webhook's active, type and url; 404 otherwise. Vendor: put-webhooks-id. |
| DELETE | `/api/2026-07/webhooks/{webhookId}` | DeleteWebhook | webhooks | Delete a webhook; empty 200, or 404. Vendor: delete-webhooks-webhookId. |
